items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I started to play with Lucky Roberts, because I've always been interested in singing and I could sing in the quartet.

ctx.x: very, very rough. So it got so rough until even Father Devine, he come into action. He's -- the apples was coming on the scene. It was rough, very, very rough. However, during that time I was very, very lucky. And after that, I think it was $100.00 and something then, but I wouldn't work because the rent was paid for a year.

Seems like something struck and tore my kingdom down. Seems like I was looking for a certain individual and she didn't show for about three months. (Inaudible). Well, the result was I'd been getting -- I started to play with Lucky Roberts, because I've always been interested in singing and I could sing in the quartet. But I was afraid to sing by myself. So Lucky Roberts and they're talking about making money. If Lucky Roberts take you in the band, you got $100.00. But you had to know all these new numbers, you…
Bermuda or take it up and take it up to Pompton Lakes. But there wasn't none of that, 'My dog got out, that's why I'm late.' No, no. He wouldn't have that.
